basic_info.headline: Software Engineer | Python,  MongoDB, Typescript, React
basic_info.about:
Passionate Software Engineer with a  background in full-stack development, including expertise in JavaScript, React, and Spring Boot. I specialize in integrating DevOps practices and cloud platforms like AWS and Microsoft Azure to deliver high-quality software solutions. My career is marked by a dedication to mentoring, training, and enhancing team performance in collaborative environments.

Previously, I was a Full Stack Software Engineer at Nisum, where I lead by example in integrating third-party APIs into scalable Spring Boot microservices and implementing robust testing strategies. My role involved close collaboration with UX designers and QA engineers to ensure accessibility and user satisfaction, while also mentoring junior engineers to elevate their skills in cutting-edge technologies.

Core Skills: Full Stack Development | JavaScript | React | Spring Boot | DevOps Practices | Cloud Platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure) | RESTful API Development | Microservices | Testing Strategy | User Experience Design | Mentorship | Collaboration

Accomplishments:
- Achieved faster processing and increased scalability by seamlessly integrating 3rd party APIs into Spring Boot microservices.
- Ensured robust software solutions with a comprehensive testing strategy, achieving 80% coverage of all possible states and workflows.
- Reduced deployment time and enhanced reliability through streamlined CI/CD integration for full-stack apps on Azure Kubernetes.

I thrive in roles that offer stability while allowing me to apply my practical approach to problem-solving and my ability to work well both independently and as part of a team. My balanced approach to work and life, combined with a dedication to upholding high standards and a knack for practical implementation, makes me an asset in environments that value clear rules and the practical application of technology.

Contact me for opportunities where my expertise in software development and my ability to lead and mentor can drive exceptional outcomes. Let's connect and explore how we can create impactful software solutions together.

experience.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
experience.description:
Delivered an accessible refactor of an ecommerce React application with a cross functional team of developers, designers, and testers

Ensured high-quality software solutions by conducting comprehensive testing of UI components using Jest and React Testing Library.

Prepared and implemented interactive demos to showcase the successful upgrade of legacy Java backend applications, seamless integration of third-party APIs into Spring Boot microservices, and various other enhancements

Designed and delivered a comprehensive training program for cohorts of up to 60 junior engineers, equipping them with advanced skills in Java 8, Spring, JavaScript, and React technologies to enhance their proficiency and productivity as Software Engineers at Nisum

Provided comprehensive technical guidance and mentorship to newly hired Junior Engineers, facilitating their onboarding process and ensuring a smooth transition into their roles

Developed and deployed full stack applications to a Kubernetes cluster in Microsoft Azure cloud, leveraging Jenkins and Gitlab for seamless CI/CD integration, ensuring efficient and reliable application delivery
